SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTER
No. I. O. D. 1209
Date 29 . 4 . 30

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, WEDNESDAY, APRIL 23, 1930.

The Pan-Pacific Association will
meet to-day at 12.15 o'clock in
the Assembly Room of the Cathay
Hotel to hear Mr. Thomas Kuo,
Delegate to the International
Labour Conference in Geneva and
head of the Labour Department of
the Ministry of Industry, Com-
merce and Labour, on the subject
"China and the International
Labour Organisation." Mr. S. U.
Zau, Vice-Minister of Industry,
Commerce and Labour, will pre-
side. Members are asked to make
reservations before Friday morn-
ing by addressing Miss A. Viola
Smith, 8 Canton Road, P. O. Box
605, or telephone 60614.

(CrS 13)
Information
Who 23 4/30

JR
Reg. Please file
23.4.'30

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记簿
编号 I. O. D. 1209
日期 30年4月29日

《字林西报》，1930年4月23日，星期三。

泛太平洋协会将于今日中午12时15分在华懋饭店会议厅举行集会，听取实业部劳工局局长、出席日内瓦国际劳工大会代表郭先生（Thomas Kuo）就“中国与国际劳工组织”这一主题发表演讲。实业部次长赵先生（S. U. Zau）将担任主席。请会员于周五上午前向广东路8号、邮政信箱605号的A. Viola Smith小姐预订，或致电60614。

(CrS 13)
